description: Skill-refinement drills for players with solid fundamentals. Introduce pressure, speed, and weak-foot challenges.

drills.name: Triangle Passing Circuit
drills.instructions: Set 3 cones 8m apart in a triangle. Pass and move to the next cone. One-touch rhythm. 5 minutes each direction. Then add: receive on back foot only.
drills.coach_tip: Decide where to pass before the ball arrives. Open your body on the receive.
drills.success_criteria: Maintain one-touch rhythm for 2 consecutive minutes.

drills.name: 1v1 Dribbling Box
drills.instructions: 5m x 5m box. Attacker dribbles to touch the far cone. Defender applies pressure. 2-minute rounds, swap. Progress: reduce box to 4m x 4m.
drills.coach_tip: Use a feint before accelerating. Commit to your move.
drills.success_criteria: Complete 6 of 10 dribble attempts against a defender.

drills.name: Shoot After Receive
drills.instructions: Partner plays ball to your feet from 5m out. Control and shoot in 2 touches. 15 attempts each foot. Add: receive from left, shoot right and vice versa.
drills.coach_tip: Set your body position before the ball arrives — don't adjust after.
drills.success_criteria: 10 of 15 shots on target from both sides.

drills.name: Change of Direction Speed Circuit
drills.instructions: Set cones in a 10m x 5m rectangle. Sprint long side, shuffle short side. 8 reps at 80% effort. Progress: add a reaction start (partner clap).
drills.coach_tip: Drive your arms — faster arms means faster feet.
drills.success_criteria: Consistent time across all 8 reps (< 10% variance).

drills.name: Weak Foot Only Passing
drills.instructions: Using only your weaker foot: pass against wall from 6m. 100 passes total. Focus on clean contact, not power. Add: vary distance from 5–10m.
drills.coach_tip: Your weaker foot only improves through dedicated volume. 100 reps minimum.
drills.success_criteria: 70% of passes are accurate and controlled.
